address_comment_regular: TES4 authoritative shared character-state velocity solver. Input block is eight hkVector4-sized slots: +0x00 response scalar x, +0x10 basis vector A, +0x20 basis vector B, +0x30 solver up/third basis, +0x40 current velocity, +0x50 desired local velocity, +0x60 max local delta x, +0x70 reference/bias velocity. Output writes the solved world/Havok velocity to the second argument.

ctree_comments.comment: Builds local solver axis0 from cross(input+0x10, input+0x20); exits if this cross product is below the small threshold at 0xA9DD54.
Builds the remaining solver basis from normalized axis0 and input+0x30, producing the matrix used by hkBasis_ProjectVector/TransformVector.
Slot +0x40 current velocity is solved relative to slot +0x70 reference/bias velocity before local projection.
Projects current-minus-reference velocity into local basis via 0x88FD90.
Slot +0x50 is desired local velocity; solver computes desired-local minus current-local.
Slot +0x60.x is max local delta. If the desired delta exceeds the allowed response-scaled delta, the local delta is clamped before applying slot +0x00 response.
Applies slot +0x00 response scalar to the local delta and adds it to current local velocity.
Transforms solved local velocity back to world/Havok vector via 0x88FE00.
Adds slot +0x70 reference/bias velocity back after transforming solved local velocity to world/Havok space.
